theorem ev_globals_eq_zero_iff (eqs : List (ℕ × ℤ × ℤ)) (hq : ∀ e ∈ eqs, e.2.2 ≠ 0)
    (φ : Formula) (x : ℕ → ℚ) :
    ev x (Formula.and (eqs.map globalEq ++ [φ])).compile = 0 ↔
      (∀ e ∈ eqs, x e.1 = e.2.1 / e.2.2) ∧ φ.Holds x := by
